items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: No, no relation. There were no relations. No. Now listen, Pete Lala's name, he was not Pete Lala. It was Pete Sika Sika. But he just gave him that name, Pete Lala.

ctx.x: Who killed him? Drip the blood.

Drip the blood. Boy, Brooks, flowers, you know. He's the one when his wife started off, he killed Billy Phillip. And the other Charlie, they were shot, injured. And Drip the blood, he was shot. He ran through the hall, ran across the street. We happened to get off the bandstand. I didn't want to, I take the rope. I said, well, I'm going to tie this rope to the piano. He says, tie it to the piano. Tie it any way. And come on down the rope. There was Peter. Oh man, look at the contract. He was praying, saying his…
And you go right out to Liberty Street, right opposite the corner there. It was Groshearts where Joe Aller was playing.

items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: I never played for Pete Lala, no.

ctx.x: I never played for Pete Lala, no.
He had a better job than Pete Lala's job, this guy. What about that one?
